auditPrograms.ClosedHyps.lean:
import DLMF
import DLMFMathlib
open Lean Meta
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
private partial def closedProps (e : Expr) (acc : Array Expr := #[]) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  match e.consumeMData with
  | .forallE _ d b _ =>
    let acc ← if !d.hasLooseBVars && !d.hasFVar && !d.hasMVar then
        (do if ← isProp d then pure (acc.push d) else pure acc) else pure acc
    closedProps b acc
  | _ => pure acc
#eval show CoreM Unit from do
  let env := (← getEnv).setExporting false
  let mut out : Array String := #[]
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.toList do
    let some mi := env.getModuleIdxFor? n | continue
    let mod := env.header.moduleNames[mi.toNat]!
    unless mod.getRoot == `DLMF || mod.getRoot == `DLMFMathlib do continue
    unless ci.isTheorem do continue
    if n.isInternal then continue
    let cs ← (closedProps ci.type).run'
    if cs.isEmpty then continue
    let axs ← collectAxioms n
    let tag := if axs.contains `sorryAx then "SORRY" else "OK"
    for c in cs do
      let pp ← (ppExpr c).run'
      out := out.push s!"{tag}\t{mod}\t{n}\t{(toString pp).replace "\n" " "}"
  IO.FS.writeFile "<out>/out/closed-hyps.tsv" (String.intercalate "\n" out.toList)
  IO.println s!"closed prop binders: {out.size}"
